ar0001.title: Creamy Penne Alfredo
ar0001.instructions:
Cook penne in salted water until al dente; drain.
Melt butter in a pan and cook garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in cream and Parmesan; simmer until thick.
Toss with penne and season.

ar0002.title: Penne Arrabbiata
ar0002.instructions:
Cook penne until al dente.
Heat oil and fry garlic and pepper flakes.
Add tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss pasta with sauce.

ar0003.title: Banana Bread
ar0003.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Combine flour, baking soda and salt.
Cream butter and brown sugar. Stir in eggs and mashed bananas.
Stir banana mixture into flour mixture.
Bake 60 to 65 minutes.

ar0004.title: Eggless Banana Bread
ar0004.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Mix dry ingredients.
Stir in oil, applesauce and bananas.
Bake 50 minutes.

ar0005.title: Vegan Banana Muffins
ar0005.instructions:
Mix flaxseed and water; let stand 5 minutes.
Mix all ingredients.
Bake 20 minutes.

ar0006.title: Egg Fried Rice
ar0006.instructions:
Heat oil and fry onion.
Add rice and soy sauce.
Push rice aside and scramble eggs, then mix.

ar0007.title: Tomato Rice
ar0007.instructions:
Fry onion in oil.
Add tomatoes and cook down.
Add rice and water; cover and cook 18 minutes.

ar0008.title: Peanut Noodles
ar0008.instructions:
Cook spaghetti.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce and garlic.
Toss and top with green onion.

ar0009.title: Shakshuka
ar0009.instructions:
Cook onion and garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set.

ar0010.title: Garlic Onion Soup
ar0010.instructions:
Caramelize onions in oil for 40 minutes.
Add garlic.
Add broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend half and serve.

ar0011.title: Simple Tomato Salad
ar0011.instructions: Arrange tomatoes, drizzle with oil and salt.

ar0012.title: Garlic Bread
ar0012.instructions:
Mix butter and garlic powder.
Spread on bread.
Bake 10 minutes.
